name: motoko-mastery-kit
validation: offline and native Motoko checks passed for all six apps; apps 01-05 run replica integration suites on pocket-ic 14.0.0 (732 checks, including mid-suite upgrades, certified queries, creator identity, disputes, Merkle proofs, ledger-verified payments, ICRC-2 escrow, signed usage receipts and invoices) and app 06 is additionally verified end to end on pocket-ic 14.0.0, including access control, per-principal quota, cycle metering and byzantine shard detection; the C2PA bridge and Verifiable Credential checks run against app 01 on a replica, and an enhanced multi-migration chain is rehearsed on a replica with a compile-time gate against unexplained changes, and the tenant sharding design is checked by an executable model; every canister interface is gated in CI for drift against the pinned compiler and for Candid subtyping against the previous release, every privileged method against the governance inventory, every dependency against the reviewed supply-chain inventory, and every canister for byte-identical Wasm from two clean builds; manifest canonicalization is RFC 8785, passing the official vectors and byte-identical to serde_jcs and the canonicalize npm package; the Merkle rules reproduce the RFC 9162 transparency-dev vectors and eddsa-jcs-2022 reproduces the W3C test vector
